public.rule: Only public-safe AI help is visible.

reader.rule: Show reader-useful AI only inside the active reading experience.

creator.rule: Show creator AI only inside creation/editing context and only for the selected format.

admin.rule: Show safety, ticket triage, damage and account AI only inside authorized Admin tools.

master_admin.rule: Show full AI governance and incident controls only inside Master Admin tools.

rules: AI feature must have a real product action, not a decorative icon.
AI icons must be context-aware and role-aware.
AI suggestions cannot silently publish or change user work.
External AI is never required for ordinary reader/creator assistance when internal capability is sufficient.
basicAuthorizationRule: Human Master Admin is highest. Master Admin AI is below Human Master Admin, may coordinate/advise above ordinary AI, but cannot override a Designated Admin role or execute an Admin action without the requesting Admin having the explicit Master-Admin-granted right. Critical/high-governance actions require the applicable human approval.

masterAdminAIHierarchy.rule: AI cannot create, remove or expand Admin authority.
